content.text:
All 66 tests pass, twice in a row.

**Summary:** I explored the live TodoMVC demo with the Playwright MCP browser tools before writing anything, which surfaced several behaviors worth pinning down rather than assuming — the delete button is `display: none` until its row is hovered (so `click()` needs an explicit hover first), a whitespace-only entry is rejected *and* leaves the text in the input, saving an empty or whitespace-only edit deletes the todo, blur saves an edit while Escape discards it, the `main`/`footer` sections aren't rendered at all when the list is empty, "mark all as complete" is global rather than view-scoped (and reflects "all done" so it un-completes everything when clicked from an empty Active view), and an unrecognised route hash falls back to "All" on a fresh load. The suite lives under `tests/` as a `TodoApp` page object (`tests/todo-app.ts`) plus six specs covering: the app shell (title, autofocus, empty state, info-footer links, URL normalising to `#/`); adding (trimming, internal whitespace, empty/whitespace-only rejection, duplicates, HTML-as-literal-text, 300-char titles, append order); completing (per-item toggle, toggle-all both directions, toggle-all reflecting individual state, counter countdown with the singular "1 item left" form); editing (double-click opens a prefilled focused editor, single click doesn't, Enter/blur/Escape semantics, trimming, empty-title deletion, completed state preserved); removing (hover-gated delete button, clear-completed visibility and scope, return to empty state); filtering and routing (all three filters with URL and `selected` class, cross-filter effects of toggling/adding/editing/deleting, direct hash navigation, unknown route, browser back/forward); and persistence (reload survival of todos, completion, edits, deletions and the selected filter, the `react-todos` localStorage shape, and restoring a seeded list). I didn't touch `playwright.config.ts` or add dependencies.
